title: Account Executive — International Markets
description:
Company: KEYDRAFT

Location: Remote / Chennai

Experience: 2–5 years

Compensation: ₹6 LPA base \+ uncapped commission

About KEYDRAFT

KEYDRAFT is a product development and technology consulting company helping startups and enterprises build, improve, and scale digital products, internal platforms, ERP systems, automation solutions, and AI\-powered products.

We’re looking for an Enterprise Account Executive who can take qualified international opportunities and turn them into long\-term KEYDRAFT clients.

This is a high\-ownership sales role. You’ll work directly with founders, CEOs, CTOs, and other senior decision\-makers, understand their business and technology requirements, develop solutions with our internal team, prepare proposals, negotiate commercials, and close deals.

What You’ll Own

You will own the sales journey from qualified opportunity to signed client:

Discovery → Requirement Understanding → Solution Positioning → Proposal → Negotiation → Closing → Handover

Key Responsibilities

\* Lead sales and discovery calls with international prospects.

\* Communicate confidently with CEOs, Founders, CTOs, CIOs, and senior executives.

\* Understand both the business problem and underlying technology requirements.

\* Ask intelligent questions to uncover the actual problem behind a client’s initial request.

\* Translate client requirements into clear project scopes and potential solutions.

\* Work closely with KEYDRAFT’s product, design, and engineering teams to shape solutions.

\* Coordinate project estimation, scope, timelines, and commercials.

\* Prepare professional proposals, presentations, estimates, and statements of work.

\* Present solutions and KEYDRAFT’s capabilities to prospective clients.

\* Handle objections related to pricing, scope, timelines, technology, and engagement models.

\* Negotiate commercials and close deals.

\* Maintain consistent follow\-ups throughout the sales cycle.

\* Maintain a healthy sales pipeline and accurate CRM records.

\* Achieve monthly and quarterly revenue targets.

\* Ensure a smooth transition from sales to the delivery team after closing.

\* Build long\-term client relationships and identify opportunities for account expansion.

What We’re Looking For

Must Have

\* 2–5 years of experience in B2B sales, account management, account executive, business development, or a similar role.

\* Proven experience closing B2B deals.

\* Previous experience selling to international clients.

\* Experience communicating with founders, CEOs, CTOs, or other senior decision\-makers.

\* Exceptional spoken and written English.

\* Comfortable conducting sales conversations with native English speakers.

\* Strong presentation, negotiation, objection\-handling, and closing skills.

\* Ability to understand technology and product\-development requirements.

\* Ability to communicate effectively with technical/product teams.

\* Strong commercial understanding.

\* Ability to take ownership of a sales pipeline and revenue target.

\* Comfortable working in a startup environment with evolving processes.

Strong Advantage

Experience selling:

\* Custom software development

\* Product development

\* SaaS

\* Technology consulting

\* AI/automation solutions

\* ERP systems

\* Digital transformation

\* Product design \+ development

\* Enterprise technology solutions

The Ideal Candidate

We’re looking for someone who can sit across a call from a CEO or CTO in the US, UK, Europe, Middle East, Australia, or other international markets and have a credible business conversation.

You don’t need to be an engineer.

But you must be comfortable talking about technology.

For example, if a prospect says:

“We need to build an internal platform that integrates with our existing ERP and automates our operations.”

You should be able to:

Understand the requirement → Ask the right questions → Identify the business opportunity → Work with our technical team → Position the right solution → Build the proposal → Negotiate → Close.

Compensation

Base: ₹6 LPA

Variable: Uncapped commission on successfully closed deals.

We are open to structuring an attractive commission model for candidates who consistently generate revenue.

Your earning potential grows directly with the revenue you bring to KEYDRAFT.

What Success Looks Like

This isn’t a role where success is simply attending sales meetings.

Your responsibility is to turn qualified opportunities into revenue.

Understand the problem → Build trust → Position KEYDRAFT → Create the proposal → Negotiate → Close.

Growth Opportunity

Enterprise Account Executive → Senior Account Executive → Enterprise Sales Manager → Head of Sales

You will have the opportunity to play a key role in building KEYDRAFT’s international enterprise sales function.

Why Join KEYDRAFT?

\* Work directly with founders and leadership.

\* Sell high\-value technology and product development services.

\* Work with international businesses and senior decision\-makers.

\* High autonomy and ownership.

\* Uncapped commission potential.

\* Opportunity to grow into a leadership role.

\* Build KEYDRAFT’s international sales function from the ground up.

\* Fast\-growing startup environment where your work directly impacts company revenue.

If you’ve successfully sold technology or product development services to international B2B clients, we want to hear from you

Pay: ₹300,000\.00 \- ₹600,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Work from home

Work Location: In person

title: Business Development Manager (BDM)
description:
SENIOR BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT MANAGER – CLOUD \& IT SALES

**Job Title:** Senior Business Development Manager  
**Location:** Chennai, Tamil Nadu  
**Experience:** 5–8 Years  
**Industry:** IT Services / Cloud / IT Infrastructure  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time

JOB SUMMARY

We are looking for an experienced **Senior Business Development Manager / Cloud Sales professional** to drive B2B and Enterprise business growth across **Cloud, IT Infrastructure, Managed Services, Data Centre, Backup \& Disaster Recovery, Networking, Cybersecurity, and System Integration solutions.**

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in **B2B IT Sales, Enterprise Sales, Cloud Sales, New Business Development, Client Acquisition, Solution Selling, Revenue Generation, and Relationship Management.**

Candidates with experience selling **Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud (GCP), or other cloud platforms** will be preferred.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Develop and execute sales strategies to acquire new B2B and Enterprise customers.
* Generate new business opportunities through cold calling, LinkedIn, email campaigns, referrals, networking, partner channels, and existing relationships.
* Identify customer requirements and recommend appropriate Cloud and IT Infrastructure solutions.
* Sell Cloud solutions across platforms such as **Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud (GCP)** and other cloud technologies.
* Promote **Cloud Migration, Cloud Managed Services, IT Infrastructure, Data Centre, Backup \& Disaster Recovery, Networking, Cybersecurity, and System Integration solutions.**
* Identify and engage senior decision\-makers including **CIOs, CTOs, IT Heads, Infrastructure Heads, and CXOs.**
* Conduct client meetings, presentations, solution discussions, commercial negotiations, and closure activities.
* Manage the complete sales lifecycle from **prospecting and qualification through proposal, negotiation, closure, and account development.**
* Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline and accurately forecast revenue.
* Achieve assigned monthly, quarterly, and annual sales and revenue targets.
* Develop long\-term relationships with key accounts and identify upselling and cross\-selling opportunities.
* Identify new market segments, industries, and business opportunities for Cloud and IT Services.
* Monitor competitor activities, market trends, and emerging Cloud and technology solutions.
* Maintain accurate customer and opportunity information in the CRM.
* Provide regular reports on sales pipeline, business development activities, revenue forecast, and sales performance.
* Work closely with **Presales, Technical, Delivery, and Support Teams** to develop appropriate solutions and proposals.

REQUIRED SKILLS \& COMPETENCIES

* Strong experience in **B2B IT Sales / Enterprise Sales / Cloud Sales / Technology Sales.**
* Proven experience in **New Business Development and Client Acquisition.**
* Strong understanding of **Cloud and IT Infrastructure solutions.**
* Experience selling at least one Cloud platform such as **Azure, AWS, GCP**, or other Cloud technologies.
* Strong consultative and solution\-selling capabilities.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.
* Ability to build relationships with **CXO and senior IT decision\-makers.**
* Strong commercial awareness and understanding of sales pipelines.
* Ability to independently manage the complete sales cycle.
* Strong target orientation with a proven record of revenue achievement.
* Good CRM, pipeline management, forecasting, and sales reporting skills.

PREFERRED TECHNOLOGY EXPOSURE

Experience in selling any of the following solutions will be an advantage:

**Microsoft Azure \| AWS \| Google Cloud (GCP) \| Cloud Migration \| Cloud Managed Services \| Cloud Infrastructure \| IT Infrastructure \| Data Centre \| Backup \& Disaster Recovery \| Networking \| Cybersecurity \| System Integration \| Managed Services**

QUALIFICATION \& EXPERIENCE

* Any Graduate / MBA in Marketing, Sales, Business Administration, or a related field.
* **5–8 years of experience** in B2B IT Sales, Cloud Sales, Enterprise Sales, Infrastructure Sales, Technology Sales, or Managed Services Sales.
* Candidates from **Cloud Services, IT Infrastructure, System Integration, Data Centre, Telecom, or Managed Services** backgrounds will be preferred.
* Candidates with demonstrated experience in **Enterprise Client Acquisition and High\-Value Solution Selling** will have an advantage.

IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

We are looking for a **hunter\-oriented sales professional** who can independently identify prospects, build relationships with decision\-makers, create opportunities, manage the sales pipeline, negotiate commercial terms, and successfully close high\-value IT and Cloud solutions.

The candidate should be comfortable working with **Enterprise and B2B customers** and have the ability to understand business requirements and position technology solutions accordingly.

Pay: ₹500,000\.00 \- ₹800,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Engineer 2, Technical Product Sales Support - Solutions Engineering-1
description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting\-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast\-forward your career at Comcast. **Job Summary**


Responsible for providing specific product and/or technical knowledge, advice and support to Sales Representatives and customers. Works as a collaborative member of the sales team to market and sell the Company's product lines. Provides insight to customers on current network situations. Works with moderate guidance in own area of knowledge.**Job Description**

**Core Responsibilities**

* Performs needs analyses for the Company and its customers and produces strategic, cost\-effective solutions.
* Provides timely, technical support and problem resolution for field service questions.
* Supports Sales team with product modifications and engineering expertise for custom projects.
* Assists representatives and customers in evaluating and selecting products.
* Creates, reviews and executes product test plans and cases, documents test progress and reports results.
* Recommends products to meet customer needs.
* Consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
* Regular, consistent and punctual attendance. Must be able to work nights and weekends, variable schedule(s) and overtime as necessary.
* Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Employees at all levels are expected to:**

* Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.
* Own the customer experience \- think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services.
* Know your stuff \- be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game\-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.
* Win as a team \- make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.
* Be an active part of the Net Promoter System \- a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company \- by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.
* Drive results and growth.
* Support a culture of inclusion in how you work and lead.
* Do what's right for each other, our customers, investors and our communities.

description:
### **What you’ll do:**



"The Sales Manager will be responsible for driving strategic sales growth for Eaton’s Crouse\-Hinds and B\-Line businesses across India, with a specific focus on managing **key EPC accounts** engaged in global projects across the **Middle East, North Africa, and other international regions**.



This role involves developing and executing a comprehensive business plan targeting **Global OEMs**, expanding into **emerging markets** such as **skid builds, green hydrogen, and other new energy applications**, and enhancing Eaton’s leadership position in **Ex\-protected and electrical infrastructure solutions**."



"


* Manage and grow relationships with key **EPC customers** in India executing projects for **MENA and global markets**.

* Develop and maintain a strong network with consultants, end\-users, and project decision\-makers to influence specifications and approvals.
* Develop a **3\-year business plan** with measurable sales targets, market share goals, and execution strategies for targeted regions and sectors.
* Drive profitability through **cost optimization**, **value engineering**, and **strategic pricing** initiatives.
* Identify and establish business opportunities in **emerging segments** such as **green hydrogen, renewable energy, skid\-based packages, and modular projects**.

* Collaborate with engineering and design teams for **lighting design**, **3D modeling**, and **solution\-based proposals** for EPC projects.

* Collaborate with **global teams** to align India\-based EPC and OEM efforts with global account strategies.


"

title: Assistant Manager – Business Development – Air Freight
description:
Key Responsibilities

* Develop and execute **Air Freight sales strategies** in line with the company's business plan.
* Identify target customer segments and develop new business opportunities.
* Generate sales leads and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.
* Acquire new customers and expand business from existing accounts.
* Achieve assigned **sales, routing, freehand sales and profit targets**.
* Handle **Tenders, RFQs and commercial negotiations**.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, agencies and trade/industrial associations.
* Network with prospective clients and identify opportunities for business growth.
* Work closely with the **Air Freight/Product teams** to develop new business and respond to market trends.
* Prepare and execute business development plans for the assigned territory.
* Manage assigned sales budgets and contribute towards maintaining the division's P\&L.
* Monitor customer shipments and coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely pickup, transportation and delivery.
* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and develop long\-term customer relationships.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities and emerging business opportunities.
* Support the Divisional Head in achieving overall Air Freight sales and revenue objectives.

Candidate Requirements

* Graduate from a reputed institution.
* **3–5 years of relevant experience in Air Freight Sales \& Marketing.**
* Experience with a reputed **Freight Forwarding / Logistics company in India** is preferred.
* Candidates with hands\-on experience in an **Air Freight Division** will be preferred.
* MBA / Post\-Graduation in **Logistics or Supply Chain Management** will be an added advantage.
* Good understanding of logistics and supply chain processes.
* Knowledge of current logistics/SCM technology and industry trends.
* Strong analytical and data\-driven approach.

Required Skills

* Air Freight Sales
* Business Development
* Freight Forwarding
* New Customer Acquisition
* Lead Generation
* Sales Pipeline Management
* Routing \& Freehand Sales
* Tender \& RFQ Management
* Commercial Negotiation
* Account Management
* Revenue \& Profitability Management
* Market Development
* Customer Relationship Management
* Sales Presentation
